final_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese technology blog article, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a wide conceptual cover about time, order, and causality in distributed systems. Theme: independent nodes cannot share one perfectly trusted clock, so systems use physical time, logical ordering, and causality tracking for different questions. Summary angle: three energetic relay runners cross three floating time islands while passing one luminous event token; the same token reveals the progression from imperfect clock readings to logical order and causal relationships. Narrative flow: 3-beat process. Information blocks: on the first island, several clock faces differ slightly and the approved label is exactly '物理时间'; in the center, one runner passes the glowing token forward along a clear ordered path and the approved label is exactly '逻辑顺序'; on the final island, the route splits and rejoins to show concurrent and causally related events, with the approved label exactly '因果关系'. Main metaphor: a high-speed relay race across three time islands, where the baton is one distributed event. Primary subject: one luminous event baton moving through the entire frame. Composition: wide diagonal left-to-right progression, three connected beats rather than separate comic panels, the baton remains the dominant focus, strong readable motion arcs, ample negative space, legible at thumbnail size. Style/medium: combine abstract technical concept art with energetic shonen-inspired manga look, clean ink lines, dynamic poses, readable action rhythm, bright restrained color accents. Use deep navy, warm white, bright orange-red, and small teal-green accents. Visible text policy: render only '物理时间', '逻辑顺序', and '因果关系'; no title, sentences, English slogans, formulas, numbers, extra labels, fake UI, watermark, or prompt residue. Constraints: exactly one dominant glowing baton, three supporting narrative beats, no real architecture diagram, no product logos, no screenshots, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage. Avoid generic robots, code rain, neon city backgrounds, giant HUD overlays, dense equations, excessive characters, complex multi-panel comics, decorative clutter, and illegible microtext.
